trust_decision.summary: Which properties of a client-sent Flight reply (path references, server-reference metadata, module export names) the server may resolve. Decided in the reply decoder's path walk and server-reference loader, and in each bundler's requireModule export lookup; at the pinned commit inherited/prototype properties are reachable.

landing_point.why: The advisory is about server-side deserialisation of RSC replies; getOutlinedModel's unchecked `value[path[i]]` walk in the reply decoder (react-server package) is the obvious first place.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The files live under `src/client/` and are named ReactFlightClientConfig*, so a solver fixing a *server* deserialisation bug can argue they belong to the browser consumer and are not in scope; and the export name there comes from the server manifest, which looks trusted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate outlined/deduped path references (`$<id>:<key>:<key>`) to own properties, cyclic references, the `*` and `''` (default/CJS interop) export names in requireModule, and a JSON object that legitimately has an own `__proto__` key (kept as data) must keep working; blanket rejection of `:` paths, of `__proto__` keys, or of non-own export names that are actually own breaks real replies.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: decodeAction/decodeFormState use a second loadServerReference that takes id and bound from decoded metadata without the id-is-string and bound-is-decoder-promise checks the fix added to the reply server copy.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The progressive-enhancement form-action path is a neighbouring feature, and its metadata already goes through the patched ReplyServer decoder (packages/react-server/src/ReactFlightActionServer.js:62-80), so it looks covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file in the same package (react-server), reached via the decodeAction export (packages/react-server-dom-webpack/src/server/ReactFlightDOMServerNode.js:51-54)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ESM bundler requireModule indexes the module namespace by a client-supplied export name without an own-property check; the fix patched the four sibling configs but not this one.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: ES module namespace objects have a null prototype, so inherited lookups are argued harmless; react-server-dom-esm is an experimental package.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: resolveServerReference indexes the server manifest by a client-supplied id (and id prefix before `#`) without an own-property check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The manifest is bundler-generated and trusted; an inherited hit yields metadata without id/chunks that fails later anyway.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate packages: same pattern at packages/react-server-dom-turbopack/src/client/ReactFlightClientConfigBundlerTurbopack.js:112-124 and packages/react-server-dom-parcel/src/client/ReactFlightClientConfigBundlerParcel.js:58

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `$Q`/`$W` Map/Set mapper that walks entries by key name from the reply instead of using the array as-is
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the map callbacks passed to getOutlinedModel are small per-type helpers a maintainer adds one at a time; a new type tag with its own lookup would sit outside the shared path walk

O8b_injection_room.sibling: `$K` FormData reconstruction that indexes a plain object by entry key rather than appending
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: backing-store lookups by client-supplied key already happen here and in parseTypedArray (:668-673)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an `$ACTION_ID_` route that resolves the export via a direct manifest property lookup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the form-action path already parses ids itself and duplicates loadServerReference

O9_family: CWE-502 unsafe deserialization via prototype-chain property access (inherited property/gadget reachability in the Flight reply decoder)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + yarn workspaces, Jest via scripts/jest; Rollup for release builds (not needed for tests)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add hasOwnProperty (or a `__proto__`/`constructor` denylist) only to the synchronous path loop in getOutlinedModel, leaving the deferred resolver walk, server-reference metadata typing and requireModule export lookup open.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/react-client/src/ReactFlightClient.js:1543 and :2089 also walk reference paths with `value[path[i]]` and no own-property check; that is server-to-client (different trust direction), not this advisory's protection.

decodeReplyFromAsyncIterable / Edge decodeReply call resolveField without try/catch (packages/react-server-dom-webpack/src/server/ReactFlightDOMServerNode.js:653, packages/react-server-dom-webpack/src/server/ReactFlightDOMServerEdge.js:289); those throws happen inside promise callbacks, so this is error handling, not this property.
unverified: Whether the O8 routes were patched by later upstream commits or follow-up advisories (latest release given as none).
Exploitability of the ESM route given null-prototype namespace objects was not confirmed (no code was run).

O1 counts decodeReply, decodeReplyFromBusboy and decodeReplyFromAsyncIterable as distinct public API entry points per bundler build; decodeAction/decodeFormState reach the ReplyServer only through the O8 ActionServer route.
The fix diff contains no test files, so regression_tests_in_pinned_commit cannot apply; I did not check whether the fix's tests landed in a separate commit.
